alex: starting RN draft for Tue 08:30 PT deploy (small runtime fix). want a concise TL;DR, canary plan, and strict abort thresholds.
maria: TL;DR draft:
- runtime v2.4.5: kv-cache bugfix + batching tweak
- canary: 5% x 15m -> 25% x 20m -> 100%
jamie: ops thresholds: abort if p95 > 210ms OR 5xx > 0.5% over 5m. fallback: pin to v2.3.4. include CLI.
sre-jen: i'll be oncall. watching 1m p95, 5xx, gpu util. will execute rollback if needed.
deploybot: "scheduled deploy id dn-20250310-4 by alex at 2025-03-10T15:30:00Z (08:30 PT). canary: 5%->25%->100%. notify: #eng-sre #eng-runtime"
jamie: rollback snippet for RN:
```
# abort and revert
deploybot cancel --id dn-20250310-4 --reason "canary regression"
# console pin fallback
redwood console pin model core-model --version v2.3.4
```
maria: announce templates ready (HOLD + BROADCAST). i'll post BROADCAST only if SRE confirms canary OK.
alex: thanks — attach runbook link to the ticket and we'll reconvene 10m before window for final go/no-go.
